title: Argentinian Vanilla Pudding with Dates
description: A creamy and sweet dessert made with Argentinian vanilla and dates, perfect for warm evenings.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the pudding and 2 cups of milk. Whisk until well combined.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the pudding comes to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the pudding has thickened.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the Argentinian vanilla extract.
Cover the saucepan with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled.
Just before serving, stir in the pitted dates.
Spoon the pudding into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
If desired, sprinkle with a pinch of smoked salt.
